reason: I'm a deal hunter and I'd rather get more for the money. $25 to $30 for 200 mg of a single form feels like a lot when I can find multi-form magnesium blends for less per day. I'd wait for a bigger coupon or flash sale.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when others put several forms in one capsule? At $0.83 to $1 a day for just bisglycinate, I don't see what I'm paying extra for besides the lab report.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $0.50 a day or a real flash sale, plus a clear reason why bisglycinate alone beats a multi-form blend.
